All changes are complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I implemented:

## Main-source feature (the actual fix)

**`JacksonCodeGenerator.java`** (build-time base generator):
- Added `getConstructorParamsJsonNames(ClassInfo)` — builds a map from constructor-parameter name → the `@JsonProperty` value declared on that parameter (only when it differs from the parameter's own name).
- Reworked `FieldSpecs` so its `jsonName` computation accepts that map. When neither the field nor the getter carries a `@JsonProperty`, it now falls back to the JSON name declared on the matching constructor parameter — keeping serialization symmetric with deserialization.
- Added a `fieldSpecsFromField(..., Map)` overload (the old signature delegates with an empty map, preserving existing behavior/deserializer path). Disambiguated the delegating `FieldSpecs` constructors with explicit casts, since a new `(FieldInfo, Map)` constructor would otherwise collide with `(FieldInfo, MethodInfo)`.

**`JacksonSerializerFactory.java`**:
- Computes the constructor-param JSON-name map once per class in `serializeObjectData` and threads it through `serializeFields` / `serializeMethods` / `fieldSpecsFromMethod` so generated serializers emit the constructor-defined names.

## Test fixtures (per the exact spec in the requirements)
- Created `TokenResponse.java` with final fields `accessToken`/`expiresIn`, a constructor annotated `@JsonProperty("access_token")` / `@JsonProperty("expires_in")`, and plain (unannotated) getters.
- Added the `POST /simple/kotlin-data-echo` endpoint (`echoKotlinData`) to `SimpleJsonResource.java`.

I left the shared test files (`SimpleJsonTest`, `AbstractSimpleJsonTest`, archives) untouched so the automatically-applied test patch wires up its `@Test` and archive entries without conflict.

## Verification
Both `compile` and `test-compile` pass. I ran a temporary standalone QuarkusUnitTest hitting `POST /simple/kotlin-data-echo` with `{"access_token":"ABC","expires_in":3600}` — it returned HTTP 200, `Content-Type: application/json`, and a body serialized with the snake_case names (`access_token`/`expires_in`), confirming the round-trip. I then removed that temporary test.
